iterative_source_discovery_summary.final_coverage_assessment: Partial. Iteration 1 confirmed: (1) One SVS boletim epidemiológico on gov.br with SE 4 data (260k probable cases, 29 deaths); (2) PAHO March 28 2024 alert with Brazil share of Americas cases; (3) State-level bulletin pages for Minas Gerais and Distrito Federal; (4) InfoDengue platform homepage; (5) Brazilian news (Folha, Agência Brasil, G1) and Cofen article with full-year 2024 totals. Missing: explicit Q1 cumulative totals (SE 1–13) at national level with confirmed/probable/suspected/deaths breakdown; national emergency declaration document; subnational (UF-level) case breakdown for Q1; PAHO or WHO situation report with Brazil-specific Q1 case counts; ReliefWeb situation reports not yet summarized.
iterative_source_discovery_summary.final_trustworthiness_assessment: High for gov.br (SVS boletim epidemiológico — primary authoritative source), paho.org (international organization — cross-validator), saude.mg.gov.br and saude.df.gov.br (state health secretariats — authoritative for subnational data). Moderate for agenciabrasil.ebc.com.br (official Brazilian government news agency — cites MoH data), g1.globo.com and folha.uol.com.br (major Brazilian news — typically cite official figures). Low for YouTube (not extractable as structured data), cofen.gov.br (nursing council — secondary aggregator), ghc.com.br (hospital group — facility-level, not population-level). Academic sources (PMC, SciELO) are peer-reviewed but may not provide Q1-specific granularity.
